page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8te.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured with 16 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

The instance features a single dedicated NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPU equipped with 48 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn8te.4xlarge offers a balanced profile for workloads requiring dedicated GPU acceleration and high memory capacity without the overhead of local storage. The combination of 16 dedicated vCPUs, 128.0 GB of RAM, and 48 GB of GPU VRAM makes this instance suitable for machine learning inference, data science pipelines, 3D rendering, and GPU-accelerated compute tasks.
